mentions.note: newcomer; won the handicap at Enfield; won 1st handicap, Enfield Open 7 Miles; 23rd 55.59; 9th Belgrave 10M Champs 83.03; 7th Essex 10 at Chigwell, county vest at first attempt; 15th Southern 10 mile 79.52 and 2nd 'Garnet' Cup (printed 'J.Lewellin'); 39th National 10 Mile 78.37, P.B., 5th Belgrave man
33rd 5:08.19; spelt Llewellin here, Llewellyn elsewhere in the issue
won Essex League walk; 10th Ilford 10km Dec 1985; 4th Basildon 50km 1986; 2nd Southern Area 20 miles 1986; father of Edward Llewellin
